prompt: Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Roboto; condensed heading with regular interface text. Use Spectrum 1-10: page #1C1D16, text #F5F7F3, accent #8AE59A, secondary surface #252C37, text on accent #111111. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
